target: Preservation of operative business constraints in full selected-document text
denominator_rule: Report all scheduled counts and invalid/uncertain outcomes; S/R eligible-pair denominators separate. Unknown is not pass or fail. Cluster by the three source families; descriptive pilot, no population precision claim.
human_review_method: One question at a time; informed author-direction review, not blind independent validation. Store exact replies and hashes; revisions append history.
